suffix: Shot on a Phase One with a 120mm macro. Pure black seamless background, #05070C. Single hard key light from upper-left, cobalt rim light from the right. Volumetric haze, visible caustics, chromatic dispersion at the edges. Extreme depth of field falloff. Physically accurate glass refraction. Cinematic, restrained, editorial. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks, no people, no faces, no user interfaces, no circuit boards, no neon, no lens flare cliché, no stock-photo composition.

slots.prompt: A single large faceted polyhedron of optical glass, suspended and slowly rotating, its interior fractured into a lattice of thin internal planes. Cobalt and ice-blue light refracts through it and scatters across the void below. The object is complete but the light passing through it is resolving into ordered structure.
variants: composition: object centered, monumental scale, generous negative space either side
composition: object off-axis in the right third, light scattering into the empty left field
composition: low camera angle looking slightly up at the object, refracted light raking forward toward the lens

slots.prompt: Molten light entering a chaotic upper region and emerging below through a precisely machined glass manifold as parallel, laminar beams of uniform width. Disorder above, order below, the transition sharp.

Hundreds of tiny glass spheres suspended in a black void, connected by hairline filaments of cobalt light. Dense clusters form and dissolve. Two clusters resolving into one — entity resolution as an optical event.
A dark monolithic block of rough basalt dissolving from its trailing edge into a swarm of clean, weightless, translucent blue cubes that reassemble ahead of it into a lighter, modular structure.

Twelve perfectly parallel translucent planes stacked in deep space, each one etched with a fine grid. A single beam of cobalt light passes through all twelve without deviation, its path traceable and unbroken. Precision as an aesthetic.

A modular lattice of interlocking translucent glass bricks, self-assembling, each brick internally illuminated with a different intensity of deep crimson-red light, hex #D6111F, with brighter scarlet highlights. Strictly monochromatic red-and-black palette — no blue, no orange, no purple, no green. Ordered, industrial, beautiful.
slots.note: client-directed: QBricks carries its own red/black product identity (#D6111F core, #FF4A50 accent — extracted from qbricks.vercel.app). The one non-cobalt slot by design.

An abstract architectural interior of black glass and polished stone, hard geometry, dawn light entering from a single high aperture. Institutional, quiet, expensive. No recognisable building.
An empty, immaculate glass-walled workspace at dawn. Cobalt light. Human absence implying human arrival.

lightStudioSuffix: Editorial product photography on a pure white seamless studio background. Soft large-source key light from the upper left with even fill; one soft contact shadow grounds the subject. Every element is cobalt blue, deep navy or clear optical glass. Cool colour temperature throughout. Crisp focus with shallow depth-of-field falloff. Shot on a Phase One with a 120mm macro. Cinematic and restrained. Negatives that proved necessary: no amber/gold/orange/warm tones and no purple (dispersion kept introducing them), no marble/granite/speckled stone (the word 'stone' produced countertops), no ceramic/bowls/tableware, no flat illustration, no bar charts or steps, plus the usual no text/logos/people/UI/neon/lens-flare.
lightStudioNote: The original black-background suffix above applies to the v1-v3 era. The v4 slot renders and the cs-* v2 set are light-studio: white seamless ground. Use lightStudioSuffix for anything new that must sit beside them.
upscaleRecipe: Krea topaz/standard-enhance, model 'Low Resolution V2', upscaling_activated true, sharpen 0.35-0.4, denoise 0.5-0.55, fix_compression 0.5-0.65, strength 0.5. face_enhancement is deliberately FALSE on every shot containing identifiable people: it is a generative pass and can alter real employees' likenesses. Low Resolution V2 resolves detail already present rather than inventing it — before/after crops were checked at 100% and features, expressions and proportions were preserved. Keep face_enhancement off for any future upscale of real photography. HARD LESSON (2026-07-27): even 'faithful' Low Resolution V2 REDRAWS SMALL FACES in group photographs — verified damage on two group shots at 2.5-4x, while large single-subject faces (headshots, 2-5 person candids) held. Rule: never upscale a photograph whose faces are smaller than ~80px in the source; inspect EVERY face at 100% before shipping, not a sample; prefer serving the original at native size and constraining the display slot instead.
freshPhotosTriage: Second client drop, 'Fresh Photos' (75 files, 74MB, gitignored at repo root — it arrived inside public/ and was moved out so the raw originals are not served). 50 unique after checksum dedupe; 25 were byte-identical copies with [nn] suffixes. Of the 50, 39 were already on the site or previously reviewed, leaving 11 genuinely new. Where shots overlapped (Amsterdam interiors, Dubai meeting rooms, several near-identical formal group photos) one was chosen per cluster.
